say:2:1421315001:1.text: Thank you guys! I never expected to get attacked in the mines...
say:2:1421315001:1.source_cn: 多、多亏你们，我完全没想到会在矿洞里遇到袭击……

say:3:1421315002:1.text: Wait, aren't you supposed to be on patrol? Where are your weapons and equipment?
say:3:1421315002:1.source_cn: 你是负责巡逻的吧？你的武器装备呢？

say:4:1421315003:1.text: My weapon was too heavy so... I left it outside. I mean, I never expected to use it!
say:4:1421315003:1.source_cn: 那个太沉了，我就放在外头了……毕竟现在这边也没什么人用了啊！

say:5:1421315004:1.text: A few days ago, there were quite a few youngsters coming and going. They might've thought it was an amusement park or something. I never expect it to be this dangerous…
say:5:1421315004:1.source_cn: 前几天还有不少年轻人在这来来去去的，可能是当成游乐场了...

say:6:1421315005:1.text: The mines are the lifeline of the dwarves! Not being responsible is one thing but why did let so many people come in and out?!
say:6:1421315005:1.source_cn: 矿洞是矮人的生命线！你、你不负责维护安全就算了，怎么还...

say:7:1421315006:1.text: If security was as tight as before, you wouldn't have been able to get in.
say:7:1421315006:1.source_cn: 要是像以前那样戒备森严，你们现在也进不来不是。

say:9:1421315008:1.text: You saw Utar, right? There are only a few of us left in the mine. If it weren't for our love of ores, we would've left by now.
say:9:1421315008:1.source_cn: 你们也见过乌塔了吧，现在矿洞里就我们几个了，要不是真爱...

choice_prompt:10:1421315008.text: You saw Utar, right? There are only a few of us left in the mine. If it weren't for our love of ores, we would've left by now.
choice_prompt:10:1421315008.source_cn: 你们也见过乌塔了吧，现在矿洞里就我们几个了，要不是真爱矿产，我们也早出去了。

say:11:1421315009:1.text: Oh, you're talking about celestrite, right?
say:11:1421315009:1.source_cn: 嗯？哦！你说的是天青矿对吧。
say:11:1421315009:1.male: Oh, you're talking about celestrite, right?
say:11:1421315009:1.female: Oh, you're talking about celestrite, right?

say:12:1421315011:1.text: Well, Eldric had us use it as a cover before. If any outsiders wanted to see echorite, we would take them to see the celestrite.
say:12:1421315011:1.source_cn: 唔，那种是弗林之前拿来对外当幌子的，如果有人想看深岩晶...

say:13:1421315012:1.text: Truth is, there's not a lot of it, and it doesn't follow the usual patterns of ore distribution. In some spots, you'll find a thick vein, and in others, there's nothing at all. It's unpredictable.
say:13:1421315012:1.source_cn: 但实际上它数量不算很多，分布也完全不按照矿石应有的规律...

say:14:1421315013:1.text: This ore is special, no doubt, but we've always had echorite to focus on, so we never mined it much. Now that there's even less of it, it's hardly worth the effort.
say:14:1421315013:1.source_cn: 这矿还算是有点特色，但我们一直有深岩晶在，就没有怎么去...

say:15:1421315014:1.text: So, yeah, there's no point. Without echorite, Brimstone Village is doomed.
say:15:1421315014:1.source_cn: 所以啊，你们放弃吧，没了深岩晶，我们深岩村就是完蛋的下场！

say:17:1421315010:1.text: Are you talking about iron ore? Ew! That's worthless... or are you talking about celestrite?
say:17:1421315010:1.source_cn: 你说铁矿？那算不了什么，到处都有……天青矿？
say:17:1421315010:1.male: Are you talking about iron ore? Ew! That's worthless... or are you talking about celestrite?
say:17:1421315010:1.female: Are you talking about iron ore? Ew! That's worthless... or are you talking about celestrite?

choice:10:1:2.text: But there are still other ores.
choice:10:1:2.male: But there are still other ores.
choice:10:1:2.female: But there are still other ores.
